title: GTA 6 on PS5 Breaks Record as Most Pre-Ordered Digital Game in PS Store History
description: Rockstar's GTA 6 has officially broken records, becoming the most pre-ordered digital game in PlayStation Store history ahead of its launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Historic Milestone for PlayStation

It was always going to be a monumental launch, but with just a week remaining until release, Rockstar has officially confirmed a massive new milestone for *GTA 6*. According to reports from gaming outlet Push Square, *GTA 6* has officially become the most pre-ordered digital game in PlayStation Store history.

This confirmation was shared via the official PlayStation Blog, courtesy of a post from Sony’s Tim Turi. While the immense popularity of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise has never been in doubt, securing the all-time digital pre-order crown on the PS Store underlines the unprecedented level of consumer anticipation surrounding the title.

## The Road to Launch

As the countdown to release enters its final week, the gaming community's attention is firmly locked on Rockstar's latest open-world epic. Breaking digital pre-order records on PlayStation 5 highlights not only the massive install base of Sony's current-gen console but also the accelerating shift toward digital-first purchases among blockbuster releases.

Industry observers note that achieving such unprecedented milestone numbers prior to launch sets a remarkably high bar for the entertainment industry at large. With expectations soaring to historic heights, all eyes are now on Rockstar as the final week ticks down.

## Editor's Take

Breaking the all-time PS Store digital pre-order record is a monumental achievement, even for a titan like Rockstar. It cements *GTA 6* not just as a highly anticipated sequel, but as a defining cultural event for the current gaming generation. The final week of waiting is going to feel agonizingly long for millions of fans worldwide.
